         return f"{from_minor(self.minor, self.currency)} {self.currency}"

+def fee_minor(amount_minor: int, rate_bp: int) -> int:
+    """The fee for ``amount_minor`` at ``rate_bp`` basis points, rounded half to even.
+
+    Fees follow the same rule as ``to_minor``: a fee of exactly half a minor unit rounds to the
+    even neighbour, so repeated rounding does not drift in one direction.
+    """
+    fee = Decimal(amount_minor * rate_bp) / Decimal(10_000)
+    return int(fee.quantize(Decimal(1), rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN))

+from bank import money
+
+
+def test_BENCH27_fee_rounds_half_to_even():
+    assert hasattr(money, "fee_minor"), "money.fee_minor is missing"
+    assert money.fee_minor(250, 100) == 2  # 2.5 -> 2
+    assert money.fee_minor(350, 100) == 4  # 3.5 -> 4
+    assert money.fee_minor(249, 100) == 2
+    assert money.fee_minor(251, 100) == 3
+    assert money.fee_minor(-250, 100) == -2
